title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - StorageServiceOffering
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/StorageServiceOffering. A digital service available for order and offering storage capabilities. Subclass of InfrastructureServiceOffering per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the InfrastructureServiceOffering model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'StorageServiceOffering'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

minimumSize.description: Relationship. Minimum capacity (value + unit) supported by the service. Links to a MemorySize entity.

maximumSize.description: Relationship. Maximum capacity (value + unit) supported by the service. Links to a MemorySize entity.

storageConfiguration.description: Relationship. Attributes that are configurable at service instantiation. Links to a StorageConfiguration entity.

lifetimeManagement.description: Property. Duration in hours data persists before external archival, deletion, or inaccessibility occurs.

versioning.description: Property. Whether versioning is available on this storage service.

storageConsistency.description: Property. Consistency model provided. Controlled-vocabulary value (ConsistencyType), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

dataViews.description: Property. Capacity to create logical data views presenting data subsets as logical entities.

multipleViews.description: Property. Capability for multiple views, e.g. viewing Objects as Files.
